findings.title: Feature-flagged dashboard tables are rendered with empty data
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, this branch renders `TableWidgetVisualization` with `columns={[]}` and a hard-coded empty `tableData` object instead of `result.data`, `result.meta`, and the widget's configured fields. Consequently every dashboard table for an enabled organization displays an empty table regardless of query results, replacing the currently working `StyledSimpleTableChart` output.

findings.title: Missing nodestore events can associate error details with the wrong error ID
findings.body: `get_multi` returns a mapping only for records that exist, but this code zips the complete `error_ids` list with `events.values()`. If an earlier error event has expired or is absent from nodestore, subsequent returned values shift left and are emitted using the wrong event ID (and potentially at the wrong timestamp). The replay summary can therefore send Seer an error title/message attributed to another error. Look up each generated node ID in the returned mapping while iterating the corresponding error ID instead of relying on `values()` alignment.

findings.title: Browser reports without either timestamp format are accepted
findings.body: Both `age` and `timestamp` are optional, and their validators only reject the other field when its value is truthy. A report containing neither field passes validation, despite the supported Reporting API formats requiring one of these time fields; reports containing `age: 0` and `timestamp: 0` also pass because both `.get()` checks are falsy. This accepts malformed reports and corrupts the collected reporting data. Add object-level validation requiring exactly one key based on field presence rather than truthiness.
